DESCRIPTION_LOC, -- [02] (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = X.CMS_CATEG_ID) AS CATEG_PATH, -- [03] X.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID, -- [04] (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M102' AND CODE = X.ITEM_GROUP) AS ITEM_GROUP_NAME, -- [05] X.DESCRIPTION_ENG AS DESCRIPTION_ENG, -- [06] X.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, -- [07] (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = X.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME, -- [08] (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = X.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, -- [09] (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M118' AND CODE = X.ITEM_GUBUN) AS ITEM_GUBUN_NAME, -- [10] (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M105' AND CODE = X.ONOFF_TYPE) AS ONOFF_TYPE_GUBUN, -- [11] X.ORDER_MEASURE AS ORDER_MEASURE, -- [12] X.DELIVERY_LT AS DELIVERY_LT, -- [13] DECODE(NVL(TRIM(X.STD_FLAG),'N'),'N','미표준화','표준화') AS STD_FLAG, -- [14] DECODE(NVL(TRIM(X.IMG_FLAG),'N'),'N','선택','필수') AS IMG_FLAG, -- [15] MD.TEXT1) ||')' AS MD_NAME, -- 28 X.CMS_PRICE , -- 29 X.CHANGE_DATE, -- 30 X.IMG_NO, -- 31 (SELECT user_name_loc FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) || '(' || (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) ||')' AS ADD_USER_NAME, --생성담당 32 X.CMS_PRICE, --표준단가 33 X.CHANGE_DATE, --표준단가수정일 34 X.KWAY_SYNERGY_FLAG, --유통시너지여부[35] X.KWAY_HANDLING_FLAG --유통취급여부[36] FROM CMSCATLG X, CMSIMGES Z , ICOMCOD1 HP , CMSCATEG CATEG , KEPSGMG SG , ICOMCOD1 MD WHERE X.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_cms_catlg_id} AND CATEG.CMS_CATEG_ID = X.CMS_CATEG_ID AND CATEG.SG_ID = SG.SG_ID(+) AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND X.IMG_NO = Z.IMG_NO(+) AND 1 = Z.RANKING(+) AND X.MAKER_CODE = HP.CODE(+) AND HP.TYPE(+) = 'M124' AND CATEG.SG_ID = MD.CODE(+) AND MD.TYPE(+) = 'C013'

/*selectMasterMdCmGoodsInfoDetailPopList3*/ SELECT XX.BUYER , XX.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , XX.BUYER_NAME , XX.BUYER_ITEM_NO , XX.DESCRIPTION_LOC , XX.SPECIFICATION , XX.UNIT_MEASURE , XX.MAKER_CODE , XX.MAKER_NAME , XX.AGENT , XX.AGENT_NAME , XX.LIST_PRICE , XX.ADD_DATE,LOCATION , XX.ADDRESS_LOC , XX.CONTRACT_NO , XX.CONTRACT_SEQ , XX.CQ_BUYER_ITEM_NO , XX.GBN , XX.MANAGER , XX.TARGET_PRICE , XX.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG , XX.CHANGE_DATE , XX.DELIVERY_LT , XX.ORDER_SEQ FROM( select CQ.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX(CQ.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE, MAX(NVL(CM.COM_NAME_LOC,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQ.BELOW_COMORG_CODE))) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(IT.DESCRIPTION_LOC) AS DESCRIPTION_LOC, MAX(IT.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(IT.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(IT.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_CODE, MAX(IT.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(CQ.AGENT) AS AGENT, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQ.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX(CQ.LIST_PRICE) AS LIST_PRICE , '' ADD_DATE, MAX(DECODE(dr_b_all,'Y','전국 ') || DECODE(dr_b_soodo,'Y','수도권 ') || DECODE(dr_b_chungnam,'Y','충남 ') || DECODE(DR_B_CHUNGBUK,'Y','충북 ') || DECODE(DR_B_GYEONGNAM,'Y','경남 ') || DECODE(DR_B_GYEONGBUK,'Y','경북 ') || DECODE(DR_B_JEONNAM,'Y','전남 ') || DECODE(DR_B_JEONBUK,'Y','전북 ')|| DECODE(DR_B_KANGWON,'Y','강원 ')|| DECODE(DR_B_JEJU,'Y','제주 ')) AS LOCATION , MAX((SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQ.AGENT)) AS ADDRESS_LOC, CQ.CONTRACT_NO , CQ.CONTRACT_SEQ , CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS CQ_BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KA' AS GBN, MAX((select user_name_loc||'('||phone_number||')' from icomlusr where user_id = it.change_user_id)) AS MANAGER, MAX(cq.target_price ) target_price , MAX(IT.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG ) REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, MAX(cq.change_date) as change_date, MAX(it.DELIVERY_LT) as DELIVERY_LT , DECODE(CQ.BUYER, 'KRGPLK0001',1,2) AS ORDER_SEQ from icombyit it, icomcqdt cq , ICOMCMPY CM , suplinfo2 INFO where it.buyer = cq.buyer and it.buyer_item_no = cq.buyer_item_no and it.status <> 'D' and cq.status <> 'D' and IT.product_close_flag <> 'S' and it.cms_catlg_id = #{st_cms_catlg_id} AND IT.BUYER = CM.COM_CODE(+) AND CQ.AGENT = INFO.SUPPLIER(+) GROUP BY CQ.BUYER , CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CQ.CONTRACT_NO, CQ.CONTRACT_SEQ ) XX ORDER BY XX.ORDER_SEQ, XX.BUYER_NAME
